title: Concept: Link to a backup or editor swap file
description: A link whose target ends in a backup or editor extension in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: Backups and swap files keep the previous contents of a script or configuration, often without the access control the live file has, and a link points straight at them.
applicability: An old configuration often carries credentials that were rotated everywhere else.
risk: Backups are copies of files whose access control was never designed for them.
